title: Outcast (PC, 1999) 2 Discs Infogrames OUTCAPC52G/B
descriptionText:
This game, titled Outcast, is a thrilling action and adventure experience that was released in 1999 for the PC platform. It comes with 2 discs and is published by Infogrames. The game is rated T-Teen and is compatible with NTSC-U/C (US/Canada) region codes. 

Immerse yourself in a captivating storyline and engage in exciting gameplay that will keep you on the edge of your seat. This game is a must-have for any video game enthusiast who loves action and adventure genres. Get your hands on this classic game today!
